BillHeading.BriefDescription: Allowing advanced registered nurse practitioners to sign and attest to certain documentation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to signatures of advanced registered nurse practitioners on required documentation; and adding a new section to chapter 18.79 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 18.79 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: An advanced registered nurse practitioner may sign and attest to any certificates, cards, forms, or other required documentation that a physician may sign, so long as it is within the advanced registered nurse practitioner's scope of practice.
